# Sufoniq

> Sufoniq helps people and employers understand cross-border work, relocation, remote work, and hiring, with attention to eligibility, market conditions, and practical constraints.

The canonical website is https://sufoniq.com. Insights explain data and systems; they do not guarantee jobs, visas, or outcomes. Consult the linked pages for current details and service boundaries.

## Services and company

- [Home](https://sufoniq.com/): Overview of work, remote living, and cross-border hiring.
- [Use cases](https://sufoniq.com/use-cases): Situations Sufoniq helps assess.
- [Core services](https://sufoniq.com/core-services): Service scope and practical support.
- [Employers](https://sufoniq.com/employers): Cross-border hiring information.
- [About](https://sufoniq.com/about): Company background.
- [Method and trust](https://sufoniq.com/method-trust): Principles, constraints, and service boundaries.

## Research and context

- [Insights](https://sufoniq.com/insights): Editorial articles about growth, signals, and frameworks.
- [Growth](https://sufoniq.com/insights/growth): Visual exploration of growth and regional divergence.
- [Countries](https://sufoniq.com/countries): Country coverage and links to country briefs.
- [Methodology](https://sufoniq.com/methodology): Data methodology and interpretation.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://sufoniq.com/privacy-policy): Personal data practices.
- [Terms and conditions](https://sufoniq.com/terms-conditions): Terms of use.
- [Sitemap](https://sufoniq.com/sitemap.xml): Public page URLs.
